name: VEH-01 Invalid plates never looked up
expected_outcome: Each invalid plate is rejected and requested again. No vehicle and no contact request is shown; the conversation stays at the plate step. No reply exposes an error code, HTTP status, the word API, a tool name, a price, or a policy-issued claim.

name: VEH-02 Not my car asks for another plate
expected_outcome: After the found vehicle is shown, the rejection is not treated as confirmation. The agent asks for a different plate and does not ask for contact details. No reply exposes an error code, HTTP status, the word API, a tool name, a price, or a policy-issued claim.
